original: dvāraṃ yāvad eva rūpāṇāṃ darśanāya iti. dvāram iva dvāraṃ hetur āśraya ity abhiprāyaḥ.

original: anenāgamena tenāśrayeṇeti yo ?rtha uktaḥ, tam eva samarthayati. tena cakṣuṣā dvāreṇa vijñānaṃ paśyati iti. darśane tatra dvārākhyā iti. cakṣur brāhmaṇa dvāram yāvad eva rūpāṇāṃ darśanāyety atra. na hy etad yujyate - darśanaṃ rūpāṇāṃ darṣanāya iti. atrāvacakatvān naitad yujyata ity abhiprāyaḥ.

original: yadi darśanaṃ karaṇam - dṛśyate ?neneti darśanam iti, kartari vā lyuṭ - paśyatīti darśanam iti, darśanāya iti ca bhāvasādhanam. dṛṣṭir darśanaṃ tasmai darśanāyeti. katham etad yujyate. yasmāc cakṣurvyatiriktaṃ darśanaṃ nāsti. ālocanam iti cet, na, vijñānāvyatiriktatvāt. vijñānam eva hy ālocanam. nāto ?nyat paśyāmaḥ.
analyzed: yadi darśanam karaṇam dṛśyate nena iti darśanam iti kartari vā lyuṭ paśyati iti darśanam iti darśanāya iti ca bhāva sādhanam dṛṣṭiḥ darśanam tasmai darśanāya iti katham etat yujyate yasmāt cakṣuḥ vyatiriktam darśanam na asti ālocanam iti ced na vijñāna a vyatirikta tvāt vijñānam eva hi ālocanam na atas nyat paśyāmaḥ

original: yadi tu cakṣurdvāraṃ vivaraṃ rūpāṇāṃ darśanāya vijñāyety artho gṛhyeta tad yujyate.
analyzed: yadi tu cakṣuḥ dvāram vivaram rūpāṇām darśanāya vijñāya iti arthaḥ gṛhyeta tat yujyate

analyzed: tat yathā kācid prajñā paśyati api ucyate iti paśyati iti api ucyate iti iti śabdaḥ tra adhyāhāryaḥ anena upanyāsena darśana vijñānayoḥ anartha antara bhāvaḥ iti darśayati kā punar asau yā prajñā evam ucyate yā darśana ātmikā uktā tad anyā ubhayathā āryā dhī SNF iti tasya evam jānataḥ evam paśyataḥ iti sūtre vacanāt

original: kiñcid iti vacanād na sarvaṃ vijñānaṃ paśyatīty uktaṃ bhavati. cakṣurvijñānaṃ hi paśyatīty ucyate, na tu śrotrādivijñānam iti.
analyzed: kiñcid iti vacanāt na sarvam vijñānam paśyati iti uktam bhavati cakṣuḥ vijñānam hi paśyati iti ucyate na tu śrotra ādi vijñānam iti

analyzed: kā anyā dṛśi kriye iti yasya upalambhaka tvam tasya darśanam yujyate iti abhiprāyaḥ tat etat acodyam iti vistaraḥ yadi vijñānam vijānāti kartṛ bhūtasya vijñānasya kā anyā vijñāna kriyā iti vaktavyam iti tulyam codyam āpadyate na ca tatra kartṛ kriyā bhedaḥ na kartuḥ vijñānasya kriyāyāḥ ca vijñāna lakṣaṇāyāḥ bhedaḥ nyatvam asti

original: bhavati ca kartṛkriyāsambandhavyapadeśaḥ - vijñānaṃ vijānāti iti. tadvad ihāpi bhavet. cakṣuḥ paśyati iti acodyam etat.
analyzed: bhavati ca kartṛ kriyā sambandha vyapadeśaḥ vijñānam vijānāti iti tadvat iha api bhavet cakṣuḥ paśyati iti acodyam etat

original: cakṣurvijñānaṃ darśanam ity apare. tasyāśrayabhāvāc cakṣuḥ paśyatīty ucyate, yathā nādasyāśrayabhāvāt ghaṇṭā nadatīty ucyate. vijñānasyāśrayabhāvād iti cakṣur vijñānasyāśrayabhāvād ity arthaḥ. tad vijñānaṃ darśanam iti rūḍhaṃ loke iti
analyzed: cakṣuḥ vijñānam darśanam iti apare tasya āśraya bhāvāt cakṣuḥ paśyati iti ucyate yathā nādasya āśraya bhāvāt ghaṇṭā nadati iti ucyate vijñānasya āśraya bhāvāt iti cakṣuḥ vijñānasya āśraya bhāvāt iti arthaḥ tat vijñānam darśanam iti rūḍham loke iti

original: darśanam iti loke rūḍham, na tu vijñānam iti rūḍham. kathaṃ gamyata ity āha - tathā hi tasminn utpanne rūpaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ity ucyate na vijñātam iti. vibhāṣāyām apy ucyata iti. sa evārtho ?bhidhīyata ity abhiprāyaḥ. cakṣuḥsamprāptaṃ cakṣurābhāsagatam.
analyzed: darśanam iti loke rūḍham na tu vijñānam iti rūḍham katham gamyate iti āha tathā hi tasmin utpanne rūpam dṛṣṭam iti ucyate na vijñātam iti vibhāṣāyām api ucyate iti saḥ eva arthaḥ bhidhīyate iti abhiprāyaḥ cakṣuḥ samprāptam cakṣuḥ ābhāsa gatam

original: vijñānaṃ tu sāṃnidhyamātreṇa iti nāśrayabhāvayogeneti darśayati. yathā sūryo divasakara iti. yathā sāṃnidhyamātreṇa sūryo divasaṃ karotīty ucyate, tathā vijñānaṃ vijānātīty ucyate. kasmāt? loke tathā siddhatvāt.
analyzed: vijñānam tu sāṃnidhya mātreṇa iti na āśraya bhāva yogena iti darśayati yathā sūryaḥ divasakaraḥ iti yathā sāṃnidhya mātreṇa sūryaḥ divasam karoti iti ucyate tathā vijñānam vijānāti iti ucyate kasmāt loke tathā siddha tvāt

original: p.118 nirvyāpāraṃ hīdam iti. vistaraḥ - nirvyāparam iti nirīham. anena hi kartur arthāntarabhūtāṃ vā kriyāṃ pratiṣedhati. dharmamātram iti svatantrasya kartuḥ pratiṣedhaṃ karoti. hetuphalamātraṃ ca iti. asaty api kartari hetuphalayoḥ kāryakāraṇam arthatvaṃ darśayati.
analyzed: nirvyāpāram hi idam iti vistaraḥ nirvyāparam iti nirīham anena hi kartuḥ artha antara bhūtām vā kriyām pratiṣedhati dharma mātram iti svatantrasya kartuḥ pratiṣedham karoti hetu phala mātram ca iti asati api kartari hetu phalayoḥ kārya kāraṇam artha tvam darśayati

original: tatra chandata upacārāḥ kriyante yad vastu vyavahārāṅgaṃ, teneha vyavahārārthasaṃsiddhyartham asad api sadrūpeṇa parikalpya kartṛkriyādivyavasthānaṃ kriyate - cakṣuḥ paśyati vijñānaṃ vijānāti ity evamādi. nātrābhiniveṣṭavyam bhāvo bhavitrapekṣo ?nya ityādi. janapadaniruktiṃ nābhiniveśeta iti. janapadas tatra niyatā niścitā coktir janapadaniruktiḥ.
analyzed: tatra chandataḥ upacārāḥ kriyante yat vastu vyavahāra aṅgam tena iha vyavahāra artha saṃsiddhi artham asat api sat rūpeṇa parikalpya kartṛ kriyā ādi vyavasthānam kriyate cakṣuḥ paśyati vijñānam vijānāti iti evamādi na atra abhiniveṣṭavyam bhāvaḥ bhavitṛ apekṣaḥ nyaḥ ityādi janapada niruktim na abhiniveśeta iti janapadaḥ tatra niyatā niścitā ca uktiḥ janapada niruktiḥ

original: tāṃ nābhiniviśeta. tasmād atreyaṃ niruktir iti. na vā sarvām evārthavatīṃ niruktiṃ kalpayet. sañjñāṃ ca lokasya nābhidhāved iti. ātmā jīva ity evamādikāṃ sañjñāṃ lokasya nādhyāropayet. abhūtasamāropeṇāsty ātmā śarīrādivyatirikta iti nātīva gacched ity arthaḥ.
analyzed: tām na abhiniviśeta tasmāt atrā iyam niruktiḥ iti na vā sarvām eva arthavatīm niruktim kalpayet sañjñām ca lokasya na abhidhāvet iti ātmā jīvaḥ iti evamādikām sañjñām lokasya na adhyāropayet abhūta samāropeṇa asti ātmā śarīra ādi vyatiriktaḥ iti na atīva gacchet iti arthaḥ

original: atha vā sañjñāṃ ca lokasya nābhidhāved nātisaret, arthābhāvāt sañjñāpi nāstīti na kalpayed ity arthaḥ. atisaraṇam atikramaṇam ity eko ?rthaḥ
analyzed: atha vā sañjñām ca lokasya na abhidhāvet na atisaret artha abhāvāt sañjñā api nā asti iti na kalpayet iti arthaḥ atisaraṇam atikramaṇam iti ekaḥ rthaḥ

original: ubhābyām api ity apiśabdād ekenāpi nātra niyamaḥ. dvayor vivṛtayoḥ pariśuddhataraṃ darśanam iti. uktaṃ bhavati - naikatarānyathībhāvād iti. unmīlitārdhanimīlitayor p.119 akṣṇoḥ ekatarasyānyathībhāvād dvayor ekatarad yady anyathībhavati, yadi yad unmīlitam, tad ardhanimīlitaṃ kriyet sarvanimīlitaṃ vā.
analyzed: ubhābyām api iti apiśabdāt ekena api na atra niyamaḥ dvayoḥ vivṛtayoḥ pariśuddhataram darśanam iti uktam bhavati na ekatara anyathībhāvāt iti unmīlita ardha nimīlitayoḥ akṣṇoḥ ekatarasya anyathībhāvāt dvayoḥ ekatarat yadi anyathībhavati yadi yat unmīlitam tat ardha nimīlitam kriyet sarva nimīlitam vā

original: yac cārdhanimīlitaṃ yadi tat sarvanimīlitaṃ kriyet sarvonmīlitaṃ vā, tadā dvicandradarśanaṃ na bhavati. ato ?vagamyate dvayor api cakṣuṣor atra vijñānotpattau vyāpāro ?stīti. deśāpratiṣṭhitatvāt rūpavad iti viparītadṛṣṭāntaḥ. yathā rūpasya deśapratiṣṭhitatvāt āśrayavicchedād vicchedo bhavati, naivaṃ vijñānasya.
analyzed: yat ca ardha nimīlitam yadi tat sarva nimīlitam kriyet sarva unmīlitam vā tadā dvi candra darśanam na bhavati atas vagamyate dvayoḥ api cakṣuṣoḥ atra vijñāna utpattau vyāpāraḥ u sti iti deśa apratiṣṭhita tvāt rūpa vat iti viparīta dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā rūpasya deśa pratiṣṭhita tvāt āśraya vicchedāt vicchedaḥ bhavati na evam vijñānasya

original: na hi vijñānaṃ deśapratiṣṭhitam, kiṃ tarhi deśāpratiṣṭhitam amūrtatvāt. deśāpratiṣṭhitatvāc ca nāśrayavicchedād vicchedo bhavati.
analyzed: na hi vijñānam deśa pratiṣṭhitam kim tarhi deśa apratiṣṭhitam amūrta tvāt deśa apratiṣṭhita tvāt ca na āśraya vicchedāt vicchedaḥ bhavati

original: tathā hi - dūrād rūpaṃ paśyati iti. yatra rūpaṃ dṛśyate, na tatra tadgrāhakaṃ cakṣurindriyam asti, tatra pramāṇānupalabhyamānatvāt, tatrāvidyamānadevadattādivat. yathā cakṣuḥ, evaṃ śrotram api vaktavyam.
analyzed: tathā hi dūrāt rūpam paśyati iti yatra rūpam dṛśyate na tatra tad grāhakam cakṣuḥ indriyam asti tatra pramāṇa anupalabhyamāna tvāt tatra avidyamāna devadatta ādi vat yathā cakṣuḥ evam śrotram api vaktavyam

original: itara āha - svaviṣayadeśaprāpti cakṣuḥśrotram, indriyatvāt, ghrāṇendriyādivat. anenānumānena tatra prāmāṇānupalabhyamānatvaṃ hetum asiddhaṃ darśayati. ācārya āha - sati ca prāptaviṣayatva iti. vistaraḥ - yadi prāptaviṣayaṃ cakṣuḥśrotraṃ kalpyeta, divyaṃ cakṣuḥśrotram iha manuṣyeṣu dhyāyināṃ nopajāyeta.
analyzed: itaraḥ āha sva viṣaya deśa prāpti cakṣuḥ śrotram indriya tvāt ghrāṇa indriya ādi vat anena anumānena tatra prāmāṇa anupalabhyamāna tvam hetum asiddham darśayati ācāryaḥ āha sati ca prāpta viṣaya tve iti vistaraḥ yadi prāpta viṣayam cakṣuḥ śrotram kalpyeta divyam cakṣuḥ śrotram iha manuṣyeṣu dhyāyinām na upajāyeta

original: yadi hi cakṣuḥśrotram api viprakṛṣṭadeśasthaṃ vyavahitaṃ ca kuḍyādibhir yathāyogaṃ rūpaṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, evam asya divyatvaṃ sambhavet. tac ca prāptaviṣayatve na syāt. ghrāṇādivat. yathā ghrāṇajihvākāyāḥ prāptaviṣayatvāt divyā dhyāyināṃ nopajāyeran, tadvat.
analyzed: yadi hi cakṣuḥ śrotram api viprakṛṣṭa deśa stham vyavahitam ca kuḍya ādibhiḥ yathāyogam rūpam śabdam gṛhṇīyāt evam asya divya tvam sambhavet tat ca prāpta viṣaya tve na syāt ghrāṇa ādi vat yathā ghrāṇa jihvā kāyāḥ prāpta viṣaya tvāt divyāḥ dhyāyinām na upajāyeran tadvat

original: anena svaviṣayadeśaprāptitvapakṣasya dharmiviśeṣaviparyayāpakṣālatvaṃ darśayati. sambhavaddivyatve hi cakṣuḥśrotre dharmī asambhavaddivyatvabhāvo viśeṣaviparyayaḥ. sa prāpnotīti doṣaḥ. anena doṣeṇānumānatvāt tatpramāṇānupalabhyamānatvaṃ siddhaṃ vyavasthāpayati. tasmād aprāptaviṣayaṃ cakṣuḥśrotram.
analyzed: anena sva viṣaya deśa prāpti tva pakṣasya darśayati sambhavat divya tve hi cakṣuḥ śrotre dharmī asambhavat divya tva bhāvaḥ viśeṣa viparyayaḥ sa prāpnoti iti doṣaḥ anena doṣeṇa anumāna tvāt tad pramāṇa anupalabhyamāna tvam siddham vyavasthāpayati tasmāt aprāpta viṣayam cakṣuḥ śrotram

original: p.120 yady aprāptaviṣayaṃ cakṣur iti. vistaraḥ - āsannenātidūrasthena tiraskṛtena vā tulyā tadaprāptir iti tatra darśanaṃ prasañjayati.

original: kim idaṃ parasya sādhanam uta dūṣanam iti? yadi tāvad evaṃ sādhanam - atidūraṃ tiraskṛtaṃ cakṣuḥśrotreṇa gṛhyate, aprāptatvāt, āsannaviṣayavad iti, tad asādhanam, hetoḥ svayam aniścitatvāt pūrvābhyupagamavirodhād vā.
analyzed: kim idam parasya sādhanam uta dūṣanam iti yadi tāvat evam sādhanam ati dūram tiraskṛtam cakṣuḥ śrotreṇa gṛhyate aprāpta tvāt āsanna viṣaya vat iti tat asādhanam hetoḥ svayam aniścita tvāt pūrva abhyupagama virodhāt vā

original: atha dūṣaṇam - sarvāprāptagrāhakatvaṃ cakṣuḥśrotralakṣaṇasya dharmiṇaḥ prasajyate, tad adūṣaṇam, anumānabādhanāt. katham ity āha - kathaṃ tāvad yaskānto na sarvam aprāptam ayaḥ karṣatīti.
analyzed: atha dūṣaṇam sarva aprāpta grāhaka tvam cakṣuḥ śrotra lakṣaṇasya dharmiṇaḥ prasajyate tat adūṣaṇam anumāna bādhanāt katham iti āha katham tāvat yaskāntaḥ na sarvam aprāptam ayaḥ karṣati iti

original: praśnamukhenāyaskāntanidarśanam upanyasya sarvāprāptāgrāhakatvaṃ cakṣuḥśrotrasya sādhayati - na sarvāprāptagrāhakaṃ cakṣuḥśrotram, sarvāprāptagrahaṇaśaktihīnatvāt, ayaskāntavat. ayaskānto hy aprāptam ayo gṛhṇāti karṣatīty arthaḥ. na ca sarvam prāptaṃ gṛhṇāti. tadvac cakṣuḥśrotram.
analyzed: praśna mukhena ayaskānta nidarśanam upanyasya sarva aprāpta agrāhaka tvam cakṣuḥ śrotrasya sādhayati na sarva aprāpta grāhakam cakṣuḥ śrotram sarva aprāpta grahaṇa śakti hīna tvāt ayaskānta vat ayaskāntaḥ hi aprāptam ayaḥ gṛhṇāti karṣati iti arthaḥ na ca sarvam prāptam gṛhṇāti tadvat cakṣuḥ śrotram

original: prāptaviṣayatve ?pi caitat samānam iti. nātidūratiraskṛto viṣayaś cakṣuḥśrotreṇa gṛhyate, grahaṇāyogyatvāt, samprāptāñjanadaśalākavat. atha vā na sarva svagrāhyagrāhi cakṣuḥśrotram, indriyasvābhāvyāt, ghrāṇendriyādivat. ghrāṇādīnāṃ hi prāpto viṣayaḥ, na tu sarvaḥ, sahabhūgandhādyagrahaṇāt.
analyzed: prāpta viṣaya tve ca etat samānam iti na ati dūra tiraskṛtaḥ viṣayaḥ cakṣuḥ śrotreṇa gṛhyate grahaṇa ayogya tvāt samprāpta añjana daśalāka vat atha vā na sarva sva grāhya grāhi cakṣuḥ śrotram indriya svābhāvyāt ghrāṇa indriya ādi vat ghrāṇa ādīnām hi prāptaḥ viṣayaḥ na tu sarvaḥ

original: ghrāṇādisahabhūni hi gandharasaspraṣṭavyāni ghrāṇādibhir na gṛhyante. śaktir hīndriyāṇām īdṛśīti.
